findings.title: A code field that deletes Arabic digits
findings.message: Typing ١٢ into this phone field kept neither ١٢ nor 12, so Arabic digits are deleted.
findings.fix: Accept Arabic-Indic digits and convert them to 0 to 9 before checking or sending the value, instead of stripping them.
findings.snippet: <input type="tel" id="phone" name="phone" class="phone-input" placeholder="050 123 4567" required="" inputmode="tel" maxlength="12" oninput="formatPhone(this)">

findings.title: Two digit systems on one screen
findings.message: "الرمز المكون من 10 أرقام الموجود على مدخ…" uses a different digit system from the rest of the screen.
findings.fix: Pick one digit system for the product and format every number with it.
findings.snippet: الرمز المكون من 10 أرقام الموجود على مدخل المبنى لتوصيل أدق وأسرع.

findings.title: Arabic lines set too tight
findings.message: Line height is 1.40 on "الرمز المكون من 10 أرقام الموجود على مدخ…".
findings.fix: Give Arabic body text a line height of about 1.6 to 1.8, for example :lang(ar) { line-height: 1.7 }.
findings.snippet: الرمز المكون من 10 أرقام الموجود على مدخل المبنى لتوصيل أدق وأسرع.

findings.title: Position, float or border that does not mirror
findings.message: left: 14px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-start, float: inline-start, border-inline-start and border-start-start-radius.

findings.title: Spacing that does not mirror

findings.fix: Use margin-inline-start, padding-inline-end and the other logical properties.
